about: Concall verdicts written by the evening check (Claude). Display only.

THELEELA.summary: Management reported a first half well ahead of its own guidance, with rates, occupancy and fees all rising and debt falling fast. They kept (did not raise) guidance and flagged a tough Q3 base, so the drift case rests on steady delivery rather than an upgrade.
points: Q2 revenue +33% to about Rs 412 Cr; EBITDA +36% at a 46% margin; profit +27% to about Rs 95 Cr.
Owned hotels: RevPAR +30%, room rate +30% to about Rs 25,000, India occupancy 69%.
Management fees +76%; about 5,200 keys contracted by FY30, over 1,000 under construction.
Net debt about Rs 1,215 Cr, 1.4x EBITDA (3.7x in March 2025); borrowing cost cut a further 30 bps.
Risks: high Q3 base (last year RevPAR ~+20%), weaker international demand, ESOP costs, Dubai JV only breakeven.
THELEELA.guidance: H2 FY27 EBITDA growth mid-to-high teens; Q3 RevPAR growth in double digits (guidance kept, not raised).
